subject.title: ci: scope PR Node tests to changed targets

question: Should canonical pull requests adopt precise changed-target Node testing, with the compact 14-job suite reserved for ambiguous and high-risk changes?
rationale: Tests establish the planner's intended boundaries, but only maintainers can accept the repository-wide coverage-versus-runner-capacity tradeoff and own future dependency-map maintenance.

options.title: Adopt after fresh integration proof
options.body: Refresh onto current main, require all exact-head checks, then merge with the compact fail-safe and monitor targeted runs for missed edges.

options.title: Keep compact PR coverage
options.body: Close or defer this PR and continue running all 14 compact Node jobs for every Node-relevant pull request.

recommendation.title: Adopt after fresh integration proof
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, require all exact-head checks, then merge with the compact fail-safe and monitor targeted runs for missed edges.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposal, implementation, review fixes, assignment, and current-main integration work for this CI policy change.
